title: Toward Human-Centered Multi-Agent Systems: Integrating Cognition, Culture, Values, and Cooperation in AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature and benchmarks (e.g., CDEval, Hofstede's cultural dimensions) to assess how language models and agents disproportionately encode dominant cultural patterns and exhibit cultural asymmetry.
Reviewing sociolinguistic research to evaluate how systems fail to adapt to pragmatic, regional, and social variations in language, instead defaulting to generic or dominant linguistic norms.

Synthesizing research on pluralistic alignment and human values to highlight how models often collapse diverse, multi-cultural values into a single, dominant default value system rather than supporting value pluralism.
